steps.instruction: Power ON (READY off if possible), foot off pedal. Keep steady.
In READY, drive 0 -> 20-30 km/h and back a couple of times (safe area).
Lift off / brake to trigger regen a few times.
steps.label: Regen / Brake

steps.instruction: Turn the AC/climate ON, then OFF.
steps.label: AC Status

steps.instruction: Open the driver door, then close it.
steps.label: Door Status

steps.instruction: Left indicator ON for a few blinks, then OFF.
steps.label: Indicator Status

steps.instruction: Unbuckle, then buckle the driver seatbelt.
steps.label: Seatbelt Status

steps.instruction: Shift P -> R -> N -> D and back to P.
steps.label: Gear State

steps.instruction: Read the ODOMETER (km) and enter it.
steps.label: Odometer

steps.instruction: Read the battery STATE OF CHARGE (%) and enter it.
steps.label: State of Charge
